justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Consistent moderate effects on pain, anxiety, depression across chronic conditions. Neuroimaging validation is robust.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 8-week practitioner training plus 5-7 day silent retreat required; high time and cost investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to almost any patient with chronic pain, stress, or lifestyle factors; cross-cutting clinical utility.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Covered by some commercial payers under behavioral health or chronic disease codes; no dedicated rehab billing code.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing demand in integrative health and behavioral health programs; increasingly listed in wellness-focused roles.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: High satisfaction; mindfulness-based skills perceived as empowering and applicable to daily life.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: MBSR programs run cash-pay 8-week cohorts at $400-600/person routinely.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Wellness positioning supports decent pricing but not premium-luxury rates.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Becoming common; many practitioners offer mindfulness; not strongly defensible.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Group-format protocol is highly leverageable across trained staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong consumer recognition of mindfulness; broad DTC interest.
justifications.business.efficiency: Teacher certification pathway is long (1-3 years) and expensive; efficiency is poor.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Viewed as adjacent/wellness credential; minimal weight in PT/OT promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Moderate evidence base, mostly outside rehab.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Tangential to core rehab curriculum; useful for pain or psychosocial threads.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Reasonable evidence for chronic pain and anxiety but heterogeneous.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never listed in rehab faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Very long teacher pathway for modest academic value.
